claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-003
Date of Incident: January 16, 2023
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 0:13 states 'INCIDENT DATE & TIME: MONDAY, JANUARY 16, 2023 AT 9:43 P.M.' This confirms the date of the incident is January 16, 2023.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 2136 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 0:13 states the incident occurred at 9:43 P.M. The claim states the time was approximately 2136 hours (9:36 P.M.). While close, 9:43 P.M. is the specific time stated in the official document shown in the video, making the claim's time inaccurate.

claims.claim_text: Location: Old Ranch Condominium development, Seal Beach, CA
Reporting Officer: Officer D. Harmon
Badge Number: 3851
Subject: Thomas Weller, Male, 47 years old, White, baggy black jacket, blue jeans, black hat
Officer(s): Officer D. Harmon, Corporal R. Fuentes
Witness(es): Female resident (W-1), reported domestic violence restraining order against subject

On January 16, 2023, at approximately 2136 hours, dispatch received a 9-1-1 call from a female resident (W-1) reporting that an unknown male was kicking her front door and demanding entry at her residence within the Old Ranch Condominium development in Seal Beach.
W-1 described the male as wearing a jacket, mask, beanie, and dark brown work boots.
claims.evidence_observations: The caller describes the person as wearing a jacket, mask, beanie, and dark brown work boots with laces, which matches the claim.

claims.claim_text: Corporal Fuentes and I were dispatched to the location.
I arrived at the residence at approximately 2140 hours and observed the property.
The residence is a two-story condominium with an enclosed rear courtyard surrounded by an approximately eight-foot-high brick perimeter wall with an entry gate facing Aster Street.
At approximately 2141 hours, I observed a male subject, later identified as Thomas Weller, standing on the concrete walkway outside the courtyard gate.
claims.evidence_observations: At 01:05, a male subject is seen standing on a concrete walkway outside a gate, matching the description of being outside the courtyard gate.

claims.claim_text: The subject was in full view and matched the description provided by dispatch.
I stood approximately 40 feet east of the subject and used my flashlight to illuminate him.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer is seen using a flashlight to illuminate the area, which aligns with the claim of using a flashlight to illuminate the subject.

claims.claim_text: I identified myself as a police officer and ordered the subject to approach me with his hands visible.
The subject stated he was there to visit a friend and asked me to call my supervisor.
claims.evidence_observations: The audio transcript states the subject asked to call his supervisor, which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject held a beverage can in his left hand throughout the encounter.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is holding a beverage can in his left hand, as seen in the video and confirmed by the audio transcript.

claims.claim_text: I noted the subject was wearing a baggy black jacket, blue jeans, and clear glasses.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is wearing a baggy black jacket and blue jeans, and appears to be wearing clear glasses, as seen in the video and confirmed by the audio transcript.

claims.claim_text: Corporal Fuentes arrived at approximately 2142 hours, parking his patrol vehicle approximately 200 to 300 feet south of the condominium.
As Corporal Fuentes approached on foot, the subject became increasingly noncompliant.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject places his left hand in his front jacket pocket and turns his back, walking toward the enclosed patio area, as seen in the video.

claims.claim_text: The subject placed his left hand in his front jacket pocket, turned his back to me, and began walking toward the enclosed patio area in the direction of W-1's residence.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject ignores repeated commands to stop and show his hands, as seen in the video where he continues walking away.

claims.claim_text: I gave repeated commands for the subject to stop and show his hands, which the subject ignored.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject states, 'I will not sit down; I will not sit down,' which is audible in the video.

claims.claim_text: The subject stated, "I will not sit down; I will not sit down."
claims.evidence_observations: At 01:05, the subject states, 'I will not sit down,' which matches the claim that he said he would not sit down.

claims.claim_text: As the subject walked back into the enclosed patio area with his back to the officers, Corporal Fuentes warned the subject that he would deploy his Taser.
claims.evidence_observations: At approximately 21:42, the subject is seen walking back into the enclosed patio area with his back to the officers, and the audio transcript indicates Corporal Fuentes warned him about deploying his Taser.

claims.claim_text: The subject continued to ignore commands.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject continues to ignore commands, as seen in the video where he walks further into the patio area without complying.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 2142 hours, Corporal Fuentes deployed his Taser, striking the subject in the chest.
claims.evidence_observations: At approximately 21:42, Corporal Fuentes deploys his Taser, striking the subject in the chest, as seen in the video where the subject is struck and falls.

claims.claim_text: The subject fell forward onto his stomach within the enclosed patio area.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject falls forward onto his stomach within the enclosed patio area, as seen in the video.

claims.claim_text: I approached the threshold of the patio and observed the subject lying face down.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer approaches the threshold of the patio and observes the subject lying face down, as seen in the video.

claims.claim_text: Corporal Fuentes was approximately ten feet to my right.
claims.evidence_observations: Corporal Fuentes is seen approximately ten feet to the officer's right, as indicated by the spatial positioning in the video.

claims.claim_text: The subject then reached toward his left waistband with his right hand and produced what appeared to be a black semi-automatic handgun.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject reaches toward his left waistband with his right hand and produces a black semi-automatic handgun, as seen in the video.

claims.claim_text: The subject raised the weapon and pointed it in my direction.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject raises the weapon and points it in the officer's direction, as seen in the video.

claims.claim_text: Fearing for my life and the life of Corporal Fuentes, I discharged my duty weapon, firing approximately twelve rounds.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer discharges his duty weapon, firing multiple rounds, as seen in the video where muzzle flashes and recoil are visible.

claims.claim_text: Corporal Fuentes simultaneously drew his duty weapon and fired approximately nine rounds.
claims.evidence_observations: Corporal Fuentes simultaneously draws his weapon and fires, as seen in the video where muzzle flashes and recoil are visible from his position.

claims.claim_text: The subject released the weapon and ceased movement.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject releases the weapon and ceases movement, as seen in the video where he drops the gun and stops moving.

claims.claim_text: After confirming the subject was no longer an active threat, Corporal Fuentes and I maintained our positions and held the subject at gunpoint.
claims.evidence_observations: After confirming the subject is no longer a threat, the officers maintain their positions and hold the subject at gunpoint, as seen in the video.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 2148 hours, Officer Pistilli arrived on scene and secured the weapon from the subject's immediate reach.
Officer Pistilli handcuffed the subject and applied a tourniquet to the subject's upper left thigh.
The weapon was later identified as a Glock 22, .40-caliber handgun, registered to the subject.
Orange County Fire Authority paramedics arrived on scene and transported the subject to UCI Medical Center, where the subject was pronounced deceased at approximately 2232 hours.
W-1 and her children confirmed unharmed.
Scene secured for investigation.
